name: uxdsl
description: This repo contains a minimal UX-focused CSS dialect (UXDSL) and tooling to load it in a Vite + React app.

scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/postcss-uxdsl test && npm --prefix packages/uxdsl-core test && node scripts/generate-language-artifacts.js --check
scripts.generate:language: npm --prefix packages/postcss-uxdsl run build && node scripts/generate-language-artifacts.js
